Manipuri: Sarvam 85.12 vs Gemini 0.55, GCV/Surya/Mistral 0.00; Textract ~0 on Indic; mni is single-vendor script, our mni probe cell is 100% sarvam_fill - never train on it
High cells need parity only: Maithili 96.70, Konkani 97.41, Nepali 97.00, Marathi 95.06; Urdu 91.21, Sindhi 91.44; allocate effort to sat/ks/or/mni
Kashmiri flat across Sarvam generations 55.93->54.82 = structural Nastaliq problem; prior-gen bench 20,267 samples: Santali 80.32, Maithili 81.95
Koshur Pixel: 500K+ synthetic Kashmiri Nastaliq renders (SynthOCR-Gen, KS-PRET-5M); 98.5% of Kashmiri is Nastaliq; slant/stacking/ligatures + Kashmiri-specific chars dropped by Urdu/Arabic models

Kraken+Arabic transfer on printed Kashmiri Nastaliq: char-acc 54.91->79.91, word-acc 4.65->44.19; Swin handwriting 95.4%, Kashmiri ligature err 5.6%; Urdu newspaper pipeline Gemini-2.5-Pro WER 0.133 vs Kraken 0.558, SR gives +25-70%; Tesseract WER 0.902 Naskh -> 1.567 Nastaliq

NE-OCR (86M ViTSTR+CTC, 1.34M pairs, CC-BY-4.0): Meitei Mayek 95.56% vs EasyOCR 2.50%/Tesseract 2.24%; Assamese 97.46% vs 32.25%; Bodo 83.38%; Chandra CER 184% on Mayek (VLM hallucination); 17.2 ms/img A40; word/line crops <=32 chars

Mozhi-LR synthetic+real: WRR Maithili 92.74/Dogri 91.85/Bodo 93.84/ks-sd-kok-sa-ne 80-90; Ol Chiki head trained synthetic only; Hindi model fails on Sindhi/Kashmiri extended chars; Tesseract/Google lack Ol Chiki; Mozhi Odia CRNN word CA 96.8-97.2
Santali: Bengali-script Santali exists (sat_14) -> script routing before recognition; Ol Chiki isolated char CNN 92% (10K chars), digits 99.13%; community Santali tessdata exists, quality unknown

Odia precedents: ori_hist Tesseract fine-tune 1875 Bible CER 48.1->17.2, WER 88.8->55.9; Qwen2.5-VL-3B LoRA-64 H100 ~12.7h ~65-70% exact; odia-ocr-merged 192K+ samples (182K char-level); Chitrapathak-2 covers Odia, must be cleared too
Odia is lowest-cost weak cell: 3-way race within ~5 pts; winnable by ensemble/wrap + conjunct fixes
Meitei Mayek: 56-class charset; small CNN 90% on Deena-2021 (1,200/class) - Mayek head does not need frontier compute
OldScan: old_scans is worst subscore for every model (dots.ocr 48.3, olmOCR-2 47.9, Paddle1.5 38.6, Tesseract 18.8, Surya 42.8, Bodhan 48.3); restoration pre-pass not recognizer swap is the attack

PreP-OCR: ResShift restoration + ByT5 post-correction cut CER 63.9-70.3% on 13,831 historical pages (Tesseract 5.91->2.00%); DocRes 5-task generalist; D2Dewarp CER -9.5-12.5%; Real5-OmniDocBench warp weakest 91.25; HIPE-OCRepair makes post-correction a judged category

OldScan restoration: no training set; ablation only: A0/A1 Otsu / A2 Sauvola / A3 DocRes pilot n<=8, adopt bar median dCER <=-0.03 with 95% CI on >=2/3 frozen engines, CPU <=3min/page; only new collection ~40-page manual old-scan eval slice
Per-cell routing: mai/kok/ne hold with off-the-shelf; sat/ks/or/mni get W6 effort; mni/as/brx need specialist (NE-OCR) or wrap, never shared training

Bodhan IndicOCR: 33M layout (PP-DocLayoutV3/RT-DETR) + 0.8B block OCR (Qwen3.5-0.8B), ~1.8GB; printed 22 langs x 13 scripts, handwriting English + 12 langs; IndicOCR-Printed bench 86.2% word acc; trained on 15M+ docs; hosted INR 0.20/image; English OmniDocBench-v1.6 92.76, olmOCR 82.2

ScriptMoE: shared encoder + image-level router -> top-2 script experts + shared expert; TextMuSS-10M synthetic; PP-OCRv5 F1 65.71->80.89; router is W6 option only after verification; reference code exists, no download
IndicPhotoOCR toolkit: TextBPN++ -> ViT script-ID -> PARSeq, 11-13 langs; BSTD 6,582 scene images; detection+script-ID quality bounds end-to-end; layout/detection deserves W6 budget

Fine-tune don't build: Chitrapathak fine-tune beats LLaVA-from-scratch on accuracy and 3-6x latency; Parichay rotation module + fine-tune 89.8% EM vs Tesseract+LLM 21.22%; Surya2 0.65B 83.3 olmOCR vs 35B 87.6 - size not decider; no-new-backbone law

SFT-first then RLVR: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 CPT +0.69, SFT +0.63, RL only +0.08 (94.93->96.33); RLVR rewards must be verifiable unit tests on gold GT, never raw CER on silver GT (olmOCR 2 precedent)

Ur word hedge RAVI 99k -> PARSeq path; sd Naskh-distractor wordlists; Paddle-Arabic excluded as ks fix

Probe/eval vs SFT-safe disjoint: only human gold may eval; synthetic may SFT never eval; every real line inherits purge gates (>=50 chars, script-ratio>=0.5, Latin<=0.6, control<=3, GT>=10 chars); PDF-layer GT trains only on 6.4 pass + 6.2 gap<=10pp + R5 trust>=70

GT-quality gates: verify 100% of fill (158 blind) + 10% stratified PDF (~77, seed 20260926); per-language >20% fail bars tier; falsification gap >10pp => PDF GT suspect; dual-blind verify not engine majority; no winners n<50
NFKC+bidi scoring normalization mandatory before CER (3-8pp artifact); WER primary; ks R5 trust ~29-45, ur 59.0 VERIFY-FIRST
